body:
From the comment in the code we can now understand why the `react-nouislider` component is not rendered when min === max.

```js
// There's no need to try to render the Slider, it will not be usable
// and will throw
```

And @vvo comment on issue https://github.com/algolia/react-nouislider/issues/34#issuecomment-283062247 is recommending to use another library. I think we should do the same and re-enable the render of the Slider when min === max but with a distinct "disabled" state.

I'm good to try to implement the use of https://github.com/airbnb/rheostat instead of `react-nouislider`, what do you think?
